title: County buying private West Maui water systems
summary: At a September 30 special meeting, a council member said the County controls delivery of 23 percent of West Maui water and private companies deliver 77 percent, and that the Council recently approved buying three water systems. The County is still in due diligence on buying other systems, aiming for about 90 percent public control.
